newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-TVL SCRAPE PAST E.P. 23-20 IN CURRIE CUP.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-TVL SCRAPE PAST E.P. 23-20 IN CURRIE CUP.

text.p: Transvaal continued their season of indifferent form with a fortunate 23-20 (halftime 13-6) victory over Eastern Province at the Boet Erasmus Stadium on Saturday.
After Transvaal fullback Gavin Lawless had missed three penalty attempts it was left to flyhalf Hennie le Roux to cancel out E.P. fullback Bertus Kruger's early penalty with a clever drop goal.

Transvaal left wing Pieter Hendrik's ran in a simple try just before the break -- his 85th for the province -- and Le Roux added a second score after fly-hacking an interception over the goal line and plunging onto it.

But E.P. staged a dramatic fightback with long periods of sustained pressure resulting in converted tries for lock Cecil du Plessis and replacement fullback Andries Fourie. From a deficit of 23-3 the home team stormed back to 20-23 and deserved at least a share of the spoils.
Eastern Province - Tries: Cecil du Plessis, Andries Fourie. Conversions: Andries Fourie (2) Penalties: Bertus Kruger (2)
Transvaal - Tries: Pieter Hendriks, Hennie le Roux Conversions: Gavin Lawless (2) Penalties: Lawless (2) Drop Goal: Le Roux.
